summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return detailing share buybacks and option exercises. The issuer repurchased 16 tranches of Class A ordinary shares between 20 March and 13 April 2026 for cancellation, totaling approximately 11.2 million shares at an average price of ~USD 6.66/share (aggregate ~USD 75M). The buybacks represent about 1.33% of outstanding shares. The filing also notes 6,200 shares issued on 28 April upon exercise of options at USD 0.50/share. This is a routine capital return disclosure; no tender offer, premium, or change of control is present. Watch for continued buyback execution as a signal of capital allocation priorities.
